name: NoctaCat
description: Ultra-lightweight, hardware-accelerated animated runner for Noctalia bar with sleep mode, multi-sensor metrics, and 40+ runner templates.

activeRunner.label: Active Runner (44 Templates)
activeRunner.desc: Choose an animal, mechanism, or character.

settings.templateAttribution: Community template with full designer attribution in CREDITS.md

drivingMetric.label: Driving Metric
drivingMetric.desc: System sensor controlling the runner speed.

audioReactive.label: Audio-Reactive Speed
audioReactive.desc: Cat pulses and speeds up to music beats.

showBadge.label: Show Percentage Badge
showBadge.desc: Display load percentage (e.g. 28%) next to the runner in the bar.

sleepMode.label: Enable Sleep Mode
sleepMode.desc: Halts animation timer completely (0% CPU) when system is idle.

sleepThreshold.label: Sleep Threshold
sleepThreshold.desc: Load level below which the runner rests after 12 seconds.

turboThreshold.label: Turbo / Overheat Threshold
turboThreshold.desc: Load level that triggers turbo animation and alert styling.

turboAlert.label: Sustained Turbo Alert
turboAlert.desc: Send desktop notification if load stays at turbo threshold for 30 seconds.

colorMode.label: Color Mode
colorMode.desc: White, Primary accent, or Rainbow mode for monochrome runners.

runnerScale.label: Runner Scale
runnerScale.desc: Scale runner size up or down to fit your bar.

speedMultiplier.label: Speed Multiplier
speedMultiplier.desc: Adjust how quickly the runner reacts to load changes.

primaryScreenOnly.label: Primary Screen Only
primaryScreenOnly.desc: Show runner only on the primary workstation bar instead of all screens.
